name: CI Monitor Agent - Auto Fix Draft PR
prompt: Dynamic ci_*** label -> derive repo. Recently pushed repos (24h), max 10. Check Actions: fail -> broken branch = target branch for PR. Before acting: if draft PR already targets broken branch, skip until broken branch changes. If broken branch changed (new commit/files): get changed files (skip deleted), create fix branch FROM broken branch, push fixes, open/update DRAFT PR targeting broken branch, label review. Pass = ignore.
